requirements.text: 每个 Cordis Host Fiber 单次激活周期创建一个私有 WorkbenchLifecycle 对象，由 Cordis 激活/卸载驱动。
对象只负责本插件内部状态、资源登记、启动、失败回滚和清理。
不注册 Service、Tool，不进入全局 Registry，不发布公共能力接口。
启动/清理失败、并发幂等和 1000 ms 清理预算按已确认语义验收。

decisions.decision: 1 Fiber activation epoch : 1 private WorkbenchLifecycle; no Registry/Service/Tool/public capability
startup rollback; terminal FAILED with cleanup diagnostics; no object resurrection
idempotent start/dispose with shared in-flight Promise; stop request during start prevents RUNNING
async cleanup budget 1000 ms; timeout is FAILED with residual diagnostics; no force-kill/retry
